_meta.description: Master catalogue of all time series used across the Analytics Hub. Single source of truth for series identity, source, and ingestion metadata.

field_reference.id: Unique machine-readable slug. Used to cross-reference series across tools and config files.
field_reference.name: Human-readable short label.
field_reference.description: What the series measures and why it matters.
field_reference.source: Data vendor: bloomberg | haver | ecb | eurostat | derived.
field_reference.ticker_bloomberg: Bloomberg ticker string (e.g. 'GDBR10 Index'). null if not available on Bloomberg.
field_reference.ticker_haver: Haver mnemonic (e.g. 'CPIEZXFE@EUDATA'). null if not available on Haver.
field_reference.units: Unit/scale of the raw series as pulled from source.
field_reference.typical_lag_days: Calendar days from reference period end to typical publication date. null for daily market data (no publication lag).
field_reference.asset_class: Grouping: macro_survey | macro_activity | macro_inflation | macro_labour | government_bonds | rates_swaps | inflation_swaps | commodities | volatility.
field_reference.geography: Primary geographic scope of the series.
field_reference.tools: List of tool IDs in the hub that consume this series.
field_reference.role: How the series is used: factor_input (DFM macro block) | target (y-variable in regression model) | predictor (x-variable) | market_data (general market series).
field_reference.internal_key: Internal variable name used in backend Python code when it differs from id.
field_reference.dfm_factor: For factor_input series: which DFM factor this series primarily identifies (Growth | Inflation | Employment | Wages).
field_reference.dfm_sign: For factor_input series: +1 if series moves in the same direction as the factor, -1 if inverse (e.g. unemployment rate is -1 for Employment factor).
field_reference.notes: Free-text caveats, data quirks, or ingestion instructions.

series.name: EA Composite PMI
series.description: S&P Global Euro Area Composite PMI Output Index. Covers manufacturing and services. Above 50 = expansion. Flash estimate is the market-moving release.
series.notes: Use flash release date as ingestion date (~3 weeks after month-end). Final release follows ~1 week later but adds little information.

series.name: EA Services PMI
series.description: S&P Global Euro Area Services PMI Business Activity Index. Flash released ~3 weeks after month-end.

series.name: EA Industrial Production (y/y)
series.description: Eurostat Euro Area industrial production index, year-on-year % change. Covers manufacturing, mining, and energy. Hard activity data complementing the PMI surveys.

series.name: EA Core HICP (y/y)
series.description: Eurostat Euro Area HICP excluding food and energy, year-on-year % change. Primary inflation gauge tracked by the ECB. Flash estimate released ~30 days after month-end.
series.notes: Use flash release date. Flash and final are almost always identical for core.

series.name: EA CES 1Y Inflation Expectations
series.description: ECB Consumer Expectations Survey: mean 1-year ahead inflation expectations (%). Released ~5-6 weeks after the reference month. Available monthly since 2020.
series.notes: Pull directly from ECB Data Portal API (dataset: ECB_CES1). Not on Bloomberg or Haver.

series.name: EA Unemployment Rate
series.description: Eurostat Euro Area harmonised unemployment rate (% of labour force), seasonally adjusted. Released ~30 days after month-end.
series.notes: Sign-flipped in DFM: higher unemployment = weaker Employment factor. Feed the raw rate level; the sign convention is handled in backend code.

series.name: EA Job Vacancy Rate
series.description: Eurostat Euro Area job vacancy rate (% of total posts). Quarterly. Released ~70 days after quarter-end.
series.notes: Quarterly; Kalman filter handles the long gaps between observations natively.

series.name: EA Negotiated Wages (y/y)
series.description: ECB indicator of negotiated wage rates for the Euro Area, year-on-year % change. Quarterly. Key ECB wage-watching indicator, released ~6-8 weeks after quarter-end.
series.notes: Primary source is ECB SDW. Bloomberg may carry as ECNWGEUR Index — verify coverage. Quarterly with long lag makes this the slowest-updating input.

series.notes: Used as log(Brent) in all HICPxT models. Log-transform applied at ingestion in the backend.

series.name: TTF Natural Gas (Front Month)
series.description: TTF (Title Transfer Facility) natural gas front-month futures price (EUR/MWh). Key driver of European energy inflation. Enters models in log form.
series.notes: Used as log(Gas) in all HICPxT models. High volatility series; especially important for the long-end forwards (10Y10Y, 20Y10Y).

series.name: EUR Rates Swaption Vol 1M
series.description: EUR interest rate swaption implied vol, 1-month expiry (normalised vol in bps). Enters only the long-end HICPxT forward models (10Y10Y, 20Y10Y) to capture convexity and vol risk premium.
series.notes: Only used in hicp_10y10y and hicp_20y10y models.
